Guilford County Superior Court

Address: 201 South Eugene Street, PO Box 3008Greensboro, NC 27402

Phone: 336-412-7300

Guilford County Superior Court, nestled in the heart of North Carolina, has been a pillar of justice for many years. But what role does it play, and what is its jurisdiction? Let's find out!

The Role and Jurisdiction

This court has broad jurisdiction over serious civil and criminal cases, handling everything from major felony charges to complex civil litigation. It stands as an integral part of North Carolina's judiciary system, ensuring justice is both served and maintained.

History of Guilford County Superior Court

Founding and Early Days

The court was founded as a part of North Carolina's constitution in 1868, serving as a cornerstone of the state's justice system ever since.

Evolution over the Years

Over the years, the court has evolved to meet the changing needs of society, expanding its services and adapting to advancements in technology.

The Court System Explained

How Cases are Filed

Anyone can file a case in Guilford County Superior Court. The process typically begins with a plaintiff filing a complaint detailing the grievance and the desired resolution.
